items.title: 14.16 Maashi, samaji aur siyasi masail (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.16 with its printed subsections, printed page 319.

blocks.text: Air pollution aur kharab air quality bhari maashi (economic) nuqsan aur samaji (social) aur siyasi (political) masail ki zimmedar hain.

items: Kharab air quality ki wajah se log beemar hote aur kaam se ghair-hazir rehte hain, is liye mazdooron ki paidawar (productivity) kam hoti hai.
Air pollution faslon ko nuqsan deti hai; is se fasal (agricultural yield) kam hoti hai aur khane ki qeematein barhti hain.
Air pollution se banne wali acid rain imaraton, pulon aur doosre infrastructure ko kharab karti hai.
Kamzor (vulnerable) log, jaise bachche, buzurg aur kam aamdani wale log, air pollution se sab se zyada mutasir hote hain.
Gandi hawa ka musalsal (chronic) exposure zindagi ka majmooi mayar (quality of life) kam karta hai; is se samaji khushhali aur community ki sehat par asar parta hai.

Shadeed air pollution logon ko gande ilaqe chhor kar behtar hawa wali jagahon par jane (migrate karne) par majboor kar sakti hai, jis se log be-ghar (displaced) hote hain aur naye masail paida hote hain.
Air quality ke moassar qawaneen lagoo karna siyasi aur maashi mafadat (interests) ki wajah se mushkil ho sakta hai.

Air pollution sarhadon (borders) tak mehdood nahi rehti, is liye is ke intezam ke liye bain-ul-aqwami taawun (international cooperation) chahiye. (Kitab mein 'corporation' chhapa hai; matlab cooperation hai.)
Air quality ke qawaneen lagoo karne ke liye sakht hukoomati nizam (strict governance) chahiye, jo industry aur maeeshat ki taraqqi ko sust kar sakta hai aur siyasi jhagron ka sabab ban sakta hai.
Air pollution se nimatne ke liye har pehlu ko dekhne wala (multi-faceted) tareeqa chahiye jo samaji-maashi aur technological pehluon mein tawazun (balance) rakhe.

blocks.title: Kitab ka lafz
blocks.text: Pehli line mein kitab 'social and potential issues' likhti hai; matlab 'social and political issues' hai, jaisa ke 14.16.3 ka unwan batata hai.

blocks.prompt: Smog ke mausam mein bhattiyan band karne ke hukoomati mansoobe se kaun se maashi, samaji aur siyasi masail uthenge?
blocks.explanation: Maashi: bhatti maalikan aur mazdooron ki aamdani rukti hai aur eenton ki qeemat barhti hai, lekin hospital ke kharche, kaam ke zaya din aur faslon ka nuqsan bachta hai. Samaji: ghareeb mazdoor nuqsan uthate hain jabke ghareeb muhallon ko sehat ka sab se zyada faida hota hai. Siyasi: maalikan pabandi ki mukhalifat karte hain, amal-daramad ke liye mazboot hukoomat chahiye, aur smog sarhadon ke paar jati hai is liye parosi ilaqon ke saath taawun zaroori hai.

items: Maashi: kam productivity, faslon ka nuqsan, infrastructure ki kharabi.
Samaji: bachche, buzurg aur ghareeb sab se zyada mutasir; zindagi ka mayar kam; hijrat (migration).
Siyasi: mafadat ki rukawat; international cooperation zaroori; governance aur taraqqi mein tawazun.
